query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.price>cat_avg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM (SELECT p.price, (SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM products p2 JOIN categories c2 USING(category,ref_id) WHERE c2.cat_lvl=1 AND c2.cat_nm='Computers & Accessories') AS cat_avg FROM products p JOIN categories c USING(category,ref_id) WHERE c.cat_lvl=1 AND c.cat_nm='Computers & Accessories' AND p.price>0) p
columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.price>cat_avg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2)
